services.name: Double Exposure
services.desc: Double up on your Alaska adventure with canyoneering and ice climbing on a glacier! Enjoy the luxuries of Alpenglow Luxury Camping and our remote Glacier Camp while you're challenging yourself to hike, climb and rappell in waterfalls. Adventure Tour price includes all meals and activities listed. No experience required but you must be over 16, in good physical condition and prepared for the challenges of the Alaska 4 Days · Challenge Level 3

services.name: Matanuska Getaway
services.desc: Make the most out of your three days. With the Matanuska Getaway you can fill your exploration with adventure and leave the nitty gritty details to us. We will pick you up in Anchorage and get you onto the trails to stretch out and get your first deep breaths of vacation right away. You'll enjoy mountain views and get a taste of Alaskan terrain. Afterwards, find yourself winding along scenic views of the Mat-Su Valley to start your evening zip line. Take in the scenery of the glacially carved valley and the Matanuska Glacier as you soar over a 250 ft cliff on Alaska's fastest zip line! Wind 3 days · Challenge Level 2

services.name: Maximum Exposure
services.desc: Take in the bird's eye view of Alaska and expand your horizons. This package offers breathtaking sights to multiple adventure destinations, some by helicopter. Start with a stunning drive to Prince William Sound for a day sea kayaking near glacier and ice bergs then overnight in the nearby gold rush town of Hope, Alaska (pop. 192). Thrilling whitewater action on Six Mile Creek kicks off the morning of Day 2. You'll relax in the comforts of Alpenglow Luxury Camping at the end of this exciting day. On Day 3, a helicopter flight will make the most of your day by promptly taking you beyond the 4 Days · Challenge Level 3

services.name: Custom Adventure Planning
services.desc: It can be overwhelming to take in all that Alaska has to offer. We are here to collaborate with you to bridge the gap between dreams and reality. Use our experience in coordinating expeditions around the world, and our familiarity with our big backyard here in Alaska, to cultivate the experience you have always wished for. Whether you are looking to get your hands dirty in the mountains, get your paddle on in the coastal regions, have an immersive educational experience, or do it all, our Alaskan experts are here to help. Getting lost in the tumultuous chaos of Anchorage whilst organizing Private Tour; Find the trip for your group with support from our team.

services.name: Ice Climbing
services.desc: Explore the Matanuska Glacier with the local Alaska ice climbing and glacier trekking experts. Fantastic photo ops, unforgettable adventure tours. Focused on your ice climbing abilities, that extensive activity gives you as much glacier as you can handle in one day. The spectacular Matanuska Glacier is a perfect place for exploring a glacier. Similarly, this giant river of ice is a great spot for an introduction to the fun and challenging sport of ice climbing, in the warm comfort of summer! This glacier has many sunny days that make for exceptional afternoons of Alaska ice climbing. Check out beautiful glacier features as you hike with your professional guide. services.name: Helicopter Adventures
services.desc: Matanuska Glacier is one of the best glaciers to enjoy in Alaska, especially by Helicopter. Our Helicopter Adventures are featured in only our best Alaska adventure packages. Exploring the Matanuska Glacier and learning to ice climb are incredible adventures. So how do you make even more of an adventure? With a helicopter. See what a Helicopter Glacier Adventure can show you. We’ve found that using a helicopter can get us to the most spectacular features of the glacier and cut out hours of hiking through the rocks. services.name: Kayak Tour
services.desc: We’ll be out in Prince William Sound for 3-days to an entire week with no chance for re-supply. It may be hot and sunny or cold and rainy for the whole time. Plan for cold and wet and anything other than that is a bonus. We like to face challenges, but no one really likes being miserable. That’s where good gear makes a difference. The best advice that we can give is “Bring what’s on this list!” You might not use it all, and that would be great. We may be paddling in rain for extended periods of time, even with the best gear we’ll eventually get a little wet. But the day usually ends with a comfortable camp, a hot meal, and dry clothes. services.name: Alaska Rafting
services.desc: Whitewater rafting Alaska’s rivers can be a private entrance into some of the most spectacular scenery. With a professional guide you can explore deep into canyons and secluded areas. Expose yourself to up close and personal interactions with the natural elements and wildlife of the Last Frontier. Additionally, we partner with a local whitewater rafting company to provide you with a quality river experience. These companies hold professional safety standards and supply the necessary dry gear to get on the rivers. With their local knowledge and river skills you are sure to have a quality river experience. services.name: ATV Tours
services.desc: Hop on an ATV or UTV and explore the back country of the Matanuska Valley. Come play in the mud. If you’re near Glacier View, near the Matanuska Glacier, enjoy this ATV tour as part of your adventure. Enjoy Alaska ATV Adventure Tour from one of the top ATV and UTV Adventure companies in Alaska. This Alaska ATV Adventure Tour activity usually goes side by side with Matanuska Glacier activities including ice climbing and glacier trekking, and maybe even some helicopter action. Alaska Adventure ATV Tours explores back country terrain so as to supply you with a healthy dose of adrenaline. blurb: Guests participate in multi-day adventure tours in Alaska's wilderness, including sea kayaking in Prince William Sound, glacier trekking, ice climbing, backpacking, and whitewater rafting. Trips emphasize active outdoor experiences with minimal time spent in vehicles. Most trips include camping and are designed for guests in good physical condition, with no prior experience required for many activities.
